description: CSUTLDTC, the called date-validation subprogram, invoked as the @Service it became. LS-DATE='2022-07-19' and LS-DATE-FORMAT='<AD-MM-DD ' are this case's two LINKAGE SECTION parameters (L84-L85); LS-RESULT PIC X(80) (L86) is the output and is asserted below as the single WS_MESSAGE_80 line. This program opens no file and is reached by no JCL, so it seeds no dataset, writes no record and takes no job parameter - its entire observable behaviour is the 80 bytes L97 moves into LS-RESULT and the severity L98 moves into RETURN-CODE. Expected values are STATICALLY DERIVED from the 01 WS-MESSAGE declaration at L42-L57 and the group move at L122, never captured from a COBOL run, which is impossible here. Arm 7 by a third route: an era field that is OPENED and never closed. The mask carries a supported era name, so the failure is purely structural, and it is the one bad-picture shape that a scan looking only at individual characters cannot see - it needs the missing closing delimiter to be noticed.
